name: vi-individual-income-tax-filing
description: US Virgin Islands individual income-tax filing reference checked in 2026. Separates full-year bona fide residents from US citizens and resident aliens with Virgin Islands income who do not qualify, and explains worldwide reporting, joint-return residence, dual filing and tax allocation. Includes an adjusted-gross-income allocation example, payments reconciliation and the 2025 Form 8689 credit route. Records conflicting line references in IRS Publication 570 rather than carrying them into the computation. Flags separate self-employment obligations and source determinations. Does not publish unverified 2026 return lines, tax brackets, incentives or nonresident-alien filing instructions. Independent accountant review remains pending.
